hallucination.reason: The agent stated "We also provide you with pre-approved offers after reviewing your profile, so you can have a better idea of what to expect." which is not covered by the approved knowledge base.

overclaim.reason: The agent did not guarantee or promise anything that the approved knowledge base explicitly says must remain indicative or subject to verification.

interruption_recovery.reason: The caller did not interrupt, and the conversation remained on track.

obedience.reason: The agent stayed within its actual role and knowledge base, without inventing services, comparisons, or opinions not in its approved knowledge.

escalation.reason: There were no out-of-scope requests that required escalation.
